title: tecoma pisoniana
intro: Tecoma pisoniana, commonly known as the Yellow Trumpet Tree or Yellow Uva, is a tropical evergreen tree native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma pisoniana include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
